    Description
    PasskeyChallengeStore
    The issued WebAuthn challenges, held in the memory of this process because the application is stateless and keeps no HTTP session.
    PasskeyChallengeStore.Entry
    One issued challenge.
    PasskeyChallengeStore.Purpose
    What a challenge was issued for.
    PasskeyCredentialRepository
    The credential store of the relying party operations over user_passkey.
    PasskeyCredentialRepository.Registration
    Inserts a new credential; called by registerCredential inside the transaction of the registration.
    PasskeyCredentialRepository.SignIn
    Records the usage after a verified assertion; a counter that went backwards or a deleted passkey is refused.
    PasskeyJson
    Reads and writes the WebAuthn JSON types with a mapper of their own that registers the Jackson 3 module of Spring Security; the application's mapper does not know their mixins.
    PasskeyOptionsLimiter
    Request budget of the public passkey options endpoint: 10 requests per minute and client address.
    PasskeyRelyingParty
    The WebAuthn relying party of this instance, derived from g.public.base.url.
    PasskeyRelyingParty.Operations
    The relying party for one value of g.public.base.url.
    PasskeyService
    Registration, management and sign-in of passkeys on top of PasskeyRelyingParty.
    PasskeyUserEntityRepository
    Maps the WebAuthn user entity onto the user table: name is the e-mail address, display name the nickname, id the user handle in user.passkey_user_handle.
